that people share, or something they can film by themselves.
identity:
EAS_apr_25,_15.57.mp3

The file begins with complete silence, but then, a tired voice breaks the stillness:

"My name is Clayton Gore, I am the head of [unintelligible].

I'm sorry, I WAS the head of [unintelligible].

I am speaking to you using the remains of the Emergency Alert System, with everything we have left here.

This is the final message.


The government has fallen.

There is nothing left.


No help is coming.  Use your weapons, clubs, fists and teeth to survive this hard time.

No one will arrest you.

No one will help you.


You're on your own.



End of transmission."
